capabilities: render \[…\] as display math, including multiline equations
reveal the original source when a rendered formula is clicked
prevent LaTeX subscripts from leaking Markdown emphasis into prose
leave inline code and fenced code blocks untouched
extras: Documents limitations: multiline \(…\) stays unrendered, and multiline \[…\] in Live Preview must occupy complete lines. Installable via BRAT or manual download. States it is offline-only, collects no telemetry, and never modifies note contents.
intentEvidence: renders standard LaTeX \(…\) and \[…\] math delimiters alongside Obsidian's native $…$ and $$…$$ syntax
problem: Obsidian only renders $…$ and $$…$$ math, so notes written with standard LaTeX delimiters show as raw text.
summary: Math renderer that displays \(…\) and \[…\] LaTeX delimiters alongside Obsidian's native $…$ and $$…$$ syntax without rewriting note source.
